articles.title: BlackRock's Fink names a U.S. recession trigger, sounds alarm over $40 trillion national debt
articles.snippet: BlackRock's CEO says "a moratorium of some sort" on data center buildouts would put the U.S. in a recession.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward to become first crypto firm to buy a EU bank as it expands into deposits, lending
articles.snippet: Payward agreed to buy Lithuania’s Saldo Bank, which holds $190 million in total assets, securing an EU license for deposits and lending.

articles.title: Kraken Owner Payward to Buy Lithuania's Saldo Bank in EU Push
articles.snippet: Co-CEO Arjun Sethi says customers want cash, crypto, tokenized stocks and credit in one place, starting with lending and cards.
